title: Both must be true
prompt: Someone can enter the robot arena only if they are at least 18 AND they have a ticket. Return true if they can enter. solve(20, true) is true; solve(16, true) is false.
hints: has_ticket is already true or false; it can go straight into an and.

docs.what: Comparisons. Each gives true or false.

docs.name: and  or  not
docs.what: and is true when both sides are; or when at least one is; not flips true and false.

solution:
func solve(age, has_ticket):
	return age >= 18 and has_ticket
